race_v2: Post hook: "Choose your guide before the race starts 🏁 (PICK ONE!)". Slimes on the track are hazards racers must slay; skipping one is the foul. Rayleigh winning is a deliberate running gag. The referee character will be replaced (known). Bennett's spec: total 16-18s, the disqualification twist lands at 12-13s; do not recommend shorter. Also Bennett's spec: top banner one short line (PICK ONE!), rules go in the caption with a small RULES chip flashing on the skip, win banner held until the referee enters, ends cutting back to the start line, closing card "Who should've won?", same music.
steal: Post hook: "Whoever gets 3 gummies wins 🍬 / Stealing is allowed. Pick a player". A pick-a-player game: viewers choose a guide before it starts; first to hold 3 gummies wins and players can steal from each other. Players must be the 4 guides only (Joy, Cyrus, Cleo, Rayleigh); the Hollow is the player-viewer and is never a competitor or pickable option.
plat: Post hook: "Pause when he lands it 🌿 / Only 1 frame works". One-frame timing challenge: Cyrus jumps to a platform and exactly one frame shows the perfect landing; the answer is deliberately never revealed, and the reel loops so viewers retry.
